nodes.title: START HERE · Pipeline overview
widgets_values:
# PixelArtistry · Free Turnaround → Multiview 3D
**Qwen-Image 2.1 (T2I + Edit) → 4-view sheet → Pixal3D Multiview**

No Nano Banana, no API, everything runs locally.

## How to use
1. **Step 1** – write your character/prop prompt (see the prompt formula note). Hit Run once to check the front view.
2. **Step 2** – the front view goes straight into the Edit node as `<image1>` and becomes a 4-view sheet in ONE row: front / left / back / right.
3. **Step 3** – the sheet is cut into four 1024×1024 squares, backgrounds are removed.
4. **Step 4–5** – Pixal3D Multiview builds shape + texture, bakes, exports the GLB.

Tip: while you iterate on Step 1, set Step 2+ to *Bypass* (Ctrl+B on the group) so you don't wait for the 3D part every time.

## Output folders (ComfyUI/output)
- `PixelArtistry/01_front`
- `PixelArtistry/02_turnaround_sheet`
- `PixelArtistry/03_views/…`
- `3d/PixelArtistry` (GLB)

## Requirements
Update ComfyUI to the latest version (Pixal3D multiview + Qwen-Image 2.1 are native core nodes). Model list: see the **Models** note.

Made by **PixelArtistry** · youtube.com/@PixelArtistry_ · Newsletter: go.pixel-artistry.com/newsletter

nodes.title: Step 3 · Crop values
widgets_values:
# Step 3 · Split the sheet
The crop values are the ones that worked in testing on a 4096-wide sheet:

| View | X | Y | W | H |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 0 | 0 | 1024 | 2688 |
| Left | 1179 | 8 | 746 | 2680 |
| Back | 1973 | 0 | 1149 | 2688 |
| Right | 3225 | 0 | 752 | 2688 |

- **Height 2688** is intentional: it's clamped to the real sheet height (Qwen often outputs 4096×1088 instead of 1024).
- **Centering is automatic:** Remove Background → Crop Image to Mask re-centers each view on a 1024×1024 square. As long as a crop holds exactly ONE view, the output is centered.
- **Two figures (or a stray hand) in one view?** Qwen placed the views a bit differently this time. Nudge X / Width of that crop until it only holds its own view, or re-roll the Step 2 seed.
- **"No input image connected"** on the crop nodes is only the preview widget (it fills from Load Image nodes only). The crop still runs – check the saved views. To adjust boxes visually, load the saved sheet into a Load Image node temporarily.

nodes.title: Step 4–5 · Pixal3D notes
widgets_values:
# Step 4–5 · Pixal3D Multiview
- **Pixal3D Multi-View Conditioning** reads the views as front / left / back / right at fixed 90° steps. The first connected view becomes the mesh's front.
- **FOV = 20** (default) – recommended for synthetic, AI-generated views.
- Shape → texture → post-processing → texture baking → GLB export, unchanged from the official template.

## Troubleshooting
- **Mesh twisted / doubled** → swap the left and right inputs on the conditioning node and run again.
- **Slab or halo around the mesh** → check the background removal previews in Step 3.
- **Thin fingers / merged belt pouches** → normal at this scale. Small inconsistencies between the views get averaged into blobs.
- **Compare**: run only the front view (disconnect left/back/right) and orbit to 90° – that's the difference multiview makes.
